template_meta.template_name: Logistics and Warehouse Business Requirement Template

business_background.summary: Inbound, putaway, inventory, picking, review, shipping, and delivery currently rely on multiple systems and manual spreadsheets. Inventory accuracy, operation efficiency, and logistics visibility are insufficient. A unified logistics warehouse system is needed to support warehouse operations, warehouse-delivery collaboration, exception handling, and analytics.
pain_points: Inbound appointment, receiving, and putaway lack unified work guidance
Inventory discrepancies are hard to detect and trace in time
Picking, review, packing, and shipping rely on manual communication and unstable efficiency
Delivery tracking, exceptions, and proof of receipt cannot be tracked consistently

objectives: Build unified management for warehouses, zones, bins, inventory, and batches
Improve efficiency and accuracy of inbound, warehouse, outbound, and delivery operations
Connect information flow among orders, warehouse, carriers, and customers
Accumulate data on turnover, operation efficiency, delivery timeliness, and exceptions
metrics: Reduce delivery exception handling time by 40%

in_scope: Inbound appointment, receiving, quality inspection, and putaway
Warehouse zones/bins, inventory, batches, freeze, and counting
Waves, picking, review, packing, and outbound handover
Carriers, waybills, delivery tracking, and proof of receipt
Returns inbound, exceptions, damage/loss, and claims
Warehouse logistics dashboards and operations reports
out_scope: Building automated storage equipment control system from scratch
Cross-border customs and international line-haul transportation

target_roles: Warehouse clerk: receiving, putaway, transfer, counting, and inventory adjustment
Picker: complete picking tasks by wave or order
Reviewer: review product, quantity, batch, and handle differences
Packer: pack, weigh, print labels, and hand over outbound parcels
Dispatcher: assign carriers, track transportation, and handle exceptions
Driver/carrier: receive waybills, pick up, transport, and return receipt
Operations supervisor: view inventory, efficiency, timeliness, and exception data
core_scenarios: Supplier or upstream system creates inbound appointment, and warehouse receives by appointment.
Warehouse clerk completes inspection, creates putaway task, and places goods into target bin.
System creates waves and picking tasks from orders; picker picks by route.
Reviewer checks goods and quantities; differences enter exception workflow.
Packer weighs, prints labels, hands over to carrier, and system syncs waybill/tracking.
Supervisor views inventory accuracy, outbound efficiency, delivery timeliness, and exceptions.

functional_requirements.overview: This requirement covers seven capability groups: inbound, warehouse inventory, picking and review, outbound shipping, transportation delivery, reverse exceptions, and analytics.

features.description: Manage appointments, arrival, receiving, quality inspection, and putaway tasks.
features.trigger: An upstream system creates an inbound order or a supplier schedules arrival.
logic: Support appointment time, supplier, carton count, SKU, and batch information
Support receiving differences, inspection results, and exception registration
Generate putaway tasks by bin strategy
features.inputs: Inbound order, supplier, SKU, batch, quantity, inspection result
features.outputs: Receiving record, putaway task, inventory increase record
features.exceptions: Over-appointment arrival, shortage/overage, inspection failure, insufficient bin capacity

features.description: Maintain warehouses, zones, bins, inventory, batches, freezes, and stock counting.
features.trigger: Inventory movement, counting plan, or internal transfer.
logic: Support available, frozen, in-transit, and batch inventory
Support transfer, replenishment, adjustment, freeze/unfreeze, and inventory ledger
Support full count, movement count, cycle count, and difference handling
features.inputs: Warehouse, bin, SKU, batch, inventory status, count order
features.outputs: Inventory ledger, inventory movement, count difference
features.exceptions: Book/physical mismatch, inventory frozen, expired batch, insufficient bin capacity

features.description: Generate waves, picking tasks, review tasks, and difference handling from orders.
features.trigger: Orders enter pending outbound or an operator creates a wave.
logic: Support waves by warehouse, carrier, SLA, and product attributes
Support picking route, full-case/broken-case picking, shortage, and substitution handling
Support scan review, difference registration, and second review
features.inputs: Order, SKU, bin, wave rule, picking task
features.outputs: Picking list, review result, difference record
features.exceptions: Shortage, wrong pick, batch mismatch, review failure

features.description: Complete packing, weighing, label printing, outbound confirmation, and carrier handover.
features.trigger: After review passes, the order enters packing and outbound.
logic: Support parcel split/merge, weighing, material records, and label printing
Support outbound handover, pickup confirmation, and inventory deduction
Support order remarks, special packaging, and dangerous-goods warnings
features.inputs: Review result, parcel, weight, label, carrier
features.outputs: Outbound order, parcel number, waybill number, handover record
features.exceptions: Label printing failure, abnormal weight, carrier rejection, outbound reversal

features.description: Manage carriers, waybills, tracking nodes, proof of receipt, and delivery exceptions.
features.trigger: After outbound, a waybill is created and handed to the carrier.
logic: Support carrier routing, freight templates, and delivery SLA rules
Support tracking subscription, node callbacks, receipt images, and electronic proof of delivery
Support delay, rejection, loss, damage, and other exception handling
features.inputs: Waybill, carrier, parcel, tracking node, receipt information
features.outputs: Logistics tracking, receipt result, exception record
features.exceptions: Tracking delay, delivery failure, lost parcel, damage, unreachable address

features.description: Handle returns, rejection, exchange, exception parcels, claims, and inventory write-back.
features.trigger: A customer returns goods, carrier rejects delivery, or warehouse finds an exception.
logic: Support return appointment, acceptance, inspection, re-putaway, or scrapping
Support exception registration, responsibility attribution, claims, and handling deadlines
Link after-sales cases, waybills, inventory, and financial status
features.inputs: Return order, exception reason, inspection result, responsible party, handling result
features.outputs: Return inbound, exception ledger, claim record
features.exceptions: Return without original order, damaged goods, unclear responsibility, overdue handling

pages.elements: Pending receiving, putaway, picking, review, exception alerts
pages.actions: Claim task, scan, submit result, view exception
pages.flow: Warehouse staff enter the workbench to claim and complete warehouse tasks.

pages.elements: Appointments, inbound orders, receiving records, inspection results, putaway tasks
pages.actions: Create appointment, receive, inspect, generate putaway, close inbound
pages.flow: Warehouse clerk receives by appointment and completes putaway.

pages.elements: Inventory ledger, bins, batches, freezes, count orders
pages.flow: Supervisor views inventory and handles differences.

pages.elements: Waves, picking lists, review tasks, parcels, labels
pages.actions: Generate wave, pick, review, pack, hand over
pages.flow: System creates tasks by order and completes outbound handover.

pages.elements: Waybills, tracking, proof of receipt, exceptions, carriers
pages.actions: Assign carrier, query tracking, handle exception, export report
pages.flow: Dispatcher tracks delivery and handles exception parcels.

pages.elements: Inventory accuracy, outbound efficiency, delivery timeliness, exception rate
pages.flow: Management reviews warehouse and delivery operation quality.

rules: Every inventory movement must create an inventory ledger entry and link to a source document.
Available inventory can be deducted and parcels generated only after outbound review passes.
The same batch should be picked by FIFO or specified batch rules.
Exceptions must record responsible party, conclusion, and handling deadline.
Waybill tracking and proof of receipt need retry and manual completion support when callbacks fail.
key_data: Warehouse: code, name, zone, bin, capacity, status
Inventory: SKU, batch, bin, available, frozen, in-transit, reserved quantity
Inbound order: supplier, SKU, quantity, appointment time, inspection result
Outbound order: order, wave, picking, review, parcel, waybill
Waybill: carrier, parcel, tracking, receipt, exception status
Exception case: type, reason, responsible party, handler, result

items: Performance: scanning operations and inventory queries need fast response; common actions complete within 2 seconds.
Accuracy: inventory, inbound, outbound, and waybill states need traceability and eventual consistency.
Mobile operations: handheld pages need to support scanning, weak network, and offline resubmission.
Audit: inventory adjustments, exception handling, and waybill manual completion must be logged.
Security: warehouse, owner, and carrier data must be isolated by permissions.

risks: Inventory discrepancies affect sales and fulfillment promises.
Unstable carrier tracking callbacks affect customer inquiry experience.
Overly complex warehouse workflows reduce frontline operation efficiency.
Unclear batch, expiry, and freeze rules can cause wrong shipment or expiry risk.
open_questions: Should multi-warehouse, multi-owner, and multi-temperature zones be supported?
Does inventory deduction happen at order, payment, or outbound stage?
Should picking strategy prioritize wave, order, zone, or batch?
Is carrier tracking subscribed by API or imported manually?
Are PDA scanning, offline operations, and electronic proof of receipt required?

milestones.acceptance: Confirm warehouse-delivery scope, inventory rules, workflows, and carrier APIs
Complete inbound, inventory, outbound, transportation, and dashboard prototypes
Complete integrations with orders, warehouse, carriers, and printing
Pilot one warehouse or business line
Complete multi-warehouse rollout, training, and acceptance
